fix_code:
def main():
    n = int(input())
    sequence = list(map(int, input().split()))
    order = []
    
    # Find the person at the front of the line
    front = sequence.index(-1) + 1
    
    # Follow the sequence to determine the order
    current = front
    while current != -1:
        order.append(current)
        current = sequence[current - 1]
    
    print(order)
